purpose_context: New and returning users hit inconsistent, confusing behavior when they mistype a mission handle or run a command without one: some commands help, others give wrong advice, and one silently scaffolds a junk mission directory. This mission makes handle resolution predictable across the CLI so people can recover from a typo and discover their available missions without reading source code. It closes GitHub issues #4631 and #4682 in the MVP-launch milestone.
purpose_tldr: Make every CLI command respond to an unknown or missing mission handle the same clear way, instead of misleading errors or an accidental junk mission folder.
source_description: Closes #4631 (nonexistent --mission diverges across plan/tasks/research/merge) and #4682 (bare `next` hard-errors instead of listing missions). Backed by two researcher-robbie root-cause briefs.
